preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input s contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Output contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(lambda i: (lambda orig, shifted: (shifted in 'code' and return_value[i] == orig) or (shifted not in 'code' and return_value[i] == shifted))(s[i], (lambda c: (lambda is_vowel, is_consonant: (chr((ord(c) - ord('a') - 5) % 26 + ord('a')) if is_vowel else (chr((ord(c) - ord('a') + 9) % 26 + ord('a')) if is_consonant else c))(c in 'aeiou', c not in 'aeiou' and c != 'y'))(c))(s[i]))(i) for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For each character, apply the shift rules (consonants +9, vowels -5, with exceptions for c, o, d, e), then revert if the result is c, o, d, or e.
